metadata.title: May 19, 2006 - Big Deel
metadata.author: By Harvey Estes / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: They may get you the upper hand
David Sarnoff was its president it for 40 years
They help you make your goals
"___ now the gulf appears in view": Byron
"Which of you shall we say doth love us most?" asker
They bring out the water cannons
"___ a Song Go Out of My Heart"
Banana skins that clowns slip on?
Org. that may say "no" to drugs
"You Can't Take It With You" director
With 120-Across, advice to a shoeless doc?
